name: Mimodactylus
sum: ‘Mimo’: an almost complete small pterosaur from the Cenomanian Sannine Formation of Lebanon.
holotype: MIM F1 — Sannine Formation Lagerstätte, Hjoula, Lebanon.
material: Almost complete skeleton with intact skull.
biology: Broad snout with cone-shaped teeth; its describers suggested it seized shrimp and other crustaceans in the water.
author: Kellner et al. 2019
